pages.text:
Terms of Reference: Online School Enrollment System
Synthetic document for a proof of concept. The school, people and figures are fictional.
1. Background
A private basic-education school (Kindergarten to Grade 12) with about 2,400 students currently runs
enrollment on paper forms and spreadsheets. Each school year, parents queue at the registrar's office for
several days, documents are checked by hand, and section lists are prepared in spreadsheets. The school
wants an online enrollment system that parents can use from home and that gives the registrar, the
accounting office and school administrators one shared view of enrollment.
2. Objectives and scope
The school is procuring the design, development, testing and deployment of a web-based, mobile-responsive
enrollment system. The system shall:
- let parents and guardians register, apply for new students and re-enroll returning students online;
- let the registrar review applications and documents, and assign students to sections;
- compute tuition and fees, and accept online payments;
- notify parents at each step and issue a certificate of enrollment;
- give administrators reports and a dashboard of enrollment status.
Users: parents/guardians (about 2,000 households), registrar staff (4), accounting staff (3), school
administrators (5) and an IT administrator (1).
Out of scope: the student information system for grades and attendance, the learning management system,
and the school's accounting system. The school will supply all computers, printers and scanners. Payment
gateway transaction fees and SMS charges are paid by the school directly to the providers.
Page 1 of 5

3. Functional requirements
3.1 Parent/guardian accounts
Parents and guardians shall create an account with their name, email address and mobile number. The
system shall send an email verification link, and the account shall stay inactive until it is verified. A parent may
link several children to one account. Parents shall be able to reset their own password.
3.2 New student enrollment application
For a new student, the parent shall complete an online application with the student's personal details, previous
school, grade level applied for, and emergency contacts. The application shall be saveable as a draft and
submitted when complete. The system shall check that all required fields are completed and that the student's
age matches the grade level rules maintained by the registrar.
3.3 Returning student re-enrollment
For a returning student, the system shall prefill the application from the previous school year so that the parent
only confirms or updates the details and selects the next grade level.
3.4 Requirements documents
Each grade level has a list of required documents (for example, birth certificate, report card, certificate of good
moral character). The parent shall upload each document as PDF or image (maximum 10 MB per file). The
system shall show a checklist of what is still missing and shall allow submission only when all required
documents are uploaded.
Page 2 of 5

3.5 Registrar review
The registrar shall review each submitted application and its documents, and either approve it or return it to
the parent with remarks for correction. A returned application can be corrected and resubmitted. The history of
review actions shall be kept.
3.6 Section assignment
After approval, the registrar shall assign each student to a section of the grade level. Each section has a
maximum capacity. The system shall suggest a section with available seats, prevent assignment beyond
capacity, and allow the registrar to move a student between sections with a recorded reason.
3.7 Tuition and fee assessment
The system shall compute the assessment for each enrolled student from the fee table of the grade level
(tuition, miscellaneous fees, other fees). It shall apply discounts maintained by the accounting office: sibling
discount, full-payment discount, and scholarship grants as a percentage. Parents choose a payment plan (full,
semestral, quarterly or monthly) and the system shall compute the schedule of due amounts.
3.8 Online payment
Parents shall pay the down payment or full amount online through a payment gateway (card and e-wallet).
The system shall mark the assessment paid when the gateway confirms payment and shall issue an
acknowledgment receipt number. The accounting office shall run a daily reconciliation that lists payments
recorded by the gateway but not matched in the system, and the reverse.
3.9 Notifications
The system shall notify parents by email and SMS when an application is submitted, returned, approved,
assessed, and paid, and when the student is officially enrolled.
Page 3 of 5

3.10 Certificate of enrollment
Once the student is officially enrolled (approved, assigned to a section, and down payment paid), the parent
shall be able to download a certificate of enrollment as PDF with the school's official layout and a QR code.
Scanning the QR code shall open a verification page showing whether the certificate is valid.
3.11 Class list report
The registrar shall be able to print the class list per section, sorted by surname, and export it to Excel.
3.12 Enrollment dashboard
School administrators shall see a dashboard showing applications by status, enrolled students per grade level
and section, seats remaining, payments collected against assessments, and daily enrollment trend compared
with the previous school year.
3.13 School setup
Administrators shall maintain school years, grade levels, sections and capacities, required documents per
grade level, age rules, fee tables and discounts. Changes shall apply only to the selected school year.
3.14 Staff users and roles
The IT administrator shall create staff accounts and assign roles (registrar, accounting, administrator, IT
administrator). Each role sees only its own menus and actions.
3.15 Audit trail
The system shall record every create, update, approval and payment action with user, date and time, and
changed values. Administrators shall be able to search the audit trail by user, student and date.
3.16 Existing student records
The current student master list (about 2,400 active students and 6 previous school years) is kept in
spreadsheets. The vendor shall migrate active students and their latest enrollment data into the system before
the start of online enrollment, with a validation report of rejected rows. The school will clean the spreadsheets
based on that report.
Page 4 of 5

4. Non-functional requirements
- Availability of 99.5% during the enrollment period (May to August).
- Pages shall load within 3 seconds for 300 concurrent parents.
- Personal data shall be protected in line with the Data Privacy Act of 2012: consent is captured at account
registration, and access is limited by role.
- The system shall work on current versions of common browsers on desktop and mobile.
5. Deliverables and timeline
1. Inception report and confirmed backlog (week 2).
2. Working increments every two weeks, demonstrated to the school.
3. Data migration rehearsal and final migration.
4. User acceptance testing by the school with vendor support.
5. Deployment to production before the enrollment period, user guides, and handover.
The school's IT administrator will be the product owner and will provide decisions within three working days.
6. Payment gateway and SMS
The school has not yet chosen its payment gateway or SMS provider. The vendor shall propose options; the
school will sign the provider contracts.
Page 5 of 5

features.name: Parent account registration and management
features.description: Parents and guardians can create accounts with name, email, and mobile number, verify their email via a link, link multiple children to one account, and reset their password.
features.route_reason: Standard user account registration and management with email verification and password reset.
features.justification: patterns-self_registration_with_email_verification precedent for self-registration with email verification
acceptance_criteria: Given a new parent or guardian, When they submit the registration form with name, email, and mobile number, Then a verification link is emailed and the account remains inactive until verified.
Given an email already registered, When a user attempts to register with it, Then the system rejects the registration without revealing account details.
Given a verified parent account, When linking children, Then multiple children can be linked to the single parent account.
Given a parent or guardian, When they request a password reset, Then they can reset their password securely.

args.query: parent account registration and management with email verification, multiple children linking, password reset

features.name: New student online application with validation and draft saving
features.description: Parents can complete an online application for new students including personal details, previous school, grade level, and emergency contacts. The application can be saved as draft and submitted when complete. The system validates required fields and age-grade level rules.
features.route_reason: Typical online form with validation and draft saving for new student application.
features.justification: Matches precedent P01-F05: multi-entity form with drafts and complex validation
acceptance_criteria: Given a partially completed application, When the parent saves, Then the application is saved as a draft and can be resumed later.
Given a submitted application with missing required fields, When submitted, Then validation errors are displayed for each missing or invalid field.
Given the student's age and grade level entered, When submitted, Then the system validates that the age matches the grade level rules maintained by the registrar.
Given a completed application, When submitted, Then the application is accepted and stored for processing.

args.query: online student application with validation and draft saving

features.name: Returning student re-enrollment with prefilled application
features.description: For returning students, the system prefills the application from the previous school year so parents can confirm or update details and select the next grade level.
features.route_reason: Prefilled form for returning student re-enrollment is a common feature.
features.justification: Rubric criterion for screen_crud with one entity and up to 30 fields with cross-field validation
acceptance_criteria: Given a returning student application, When the parent accesses it, Then the application is prefilled with previous year data for confirmation or update.
Given the prefilled application, When the parent submits, Then the next grade level is selected and saved.
Given a new or returning student, When the parent starts an application, Then the system allows online registration and enrollment as per TOR p1 and p2.

features.name: Upload and checklist of required documents per grade level
features.description: Parents upload required documents as PDF or images (max 10MB each). The system shows a checklist of missing documents and allows submission only when all required documents are uploaded.
features.route_reason: Document upload with checklist and submission gating is standard functionality.
features.justification: patterns-document_upload_and_management typical size M for document upload with checklist and validation
acceptance_criteria: Given a parent uploads a document over 10 MB, When the upload is attempted, Then the system rejects the file with an error message.
Given a checklist of required documents per grade level, When the parent uploads all required documents, Then the checklist shows all documents as complete and submission is enabled.
Given missing required documents, When the parent views the checklist, Then the system shows which documents are still missing.
Given all required documents are uploaded, When the parent submits the application, Then the system allows submission to proceed.

args.query: upload documents checklist submission required documents per grade level

features.epic: Registrar Application Review and Section Assignment
features.name: Registrar review of applications with approval, return, and history
features.description: Registrar reviews submitted applications and documents, approves or returns them with remarks. Returned applications can be corrected and resubmitted. The system keeps a history of review actions.
features.route_reason: Registrar review workflow with approval, return, and history is typical business process.
features.justification: return-for-correction loop increases size to M per patterns-single_level_approval and rubric
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted application, When the registrar approves it, Then the application status becomes 'Approved' and the action is recorded in history.
Given a submitted application, When the registrar returns it with remarks, Then the parent can correct and resubmit the application.
Given a returned application, When corrected and resubmitted, Then the registrar can review it again.
Given any review action, When viewed, Then the system shows the full history of review actions.

args.query: registrar review applications approve return history

features.epic: Registrar Application Review and Section Assignment
features.name: Section assignment with capacity checks and reassignment
features.description: After approval, registrar assigns students to sections. The system suggests sections with available seats, prevents overcapacity assignments, and allows moving students between sections with recorded reasons.
features.route_reason: Section assignment with capacity checks and reassignment is a common administrative feature.
features.justification: Matches pattern appointment_slot_booking workflow with capacity checks and reassignment
acceptance_criteria: Given a student approved for assignment, When the registrar assigns the student to a section, Then the system suggests sections with available seats (p3).
Given a section at full capacity, When the registrar attempts to assign a student, Then the system prevents the assignment (p3).
Given a student assigned to a section, When the registrar moves the student to another section, Then the system records the reason for reassignment (p3).
Given the registrar reviews applications, When assigning students to sections, Then the system enforces section capacity limits and records assignment history (p1, p3).

args.query: student section assignment with capacity check and reassignment

features.name: Tuition and fee computation with discounts and payment plans
features.description: The system computes tuition and fees per enrolled student based on grade level fee tables, applies discounts (sibling, full-payment, scholarships), and calculates payment schedules for chosen plans (full, semestral, quarterly, monthly).
features.route_reason: Tuition and fee computation with discounts and payment plans is standard financial logic.
features.justification: patterns-fee_assessment_computation_rules typical size L for fee computation workflows
acceptance_criteria: Given an enrolled student with grade level, When assessment is computed, Then tuition, miscellaneous, and other fees are calculated from the fee table (p3).
Given applicable discounts (sibling, full-payment, scholarships), When assessment is computed, Then discounts are applied as percentages (p3).
Given a chosen payment plan (full, semestral, quarterly, monthly), When schedule is computed, Then due amounts are calculated accordingly (p3).
Given an online payment, When payment is processed, Then the system records payment and updates assessment status (p1).

args.query: tuition and fee computation with discounts and payment plans

features.name: Online payment processing and receipt issuance
features.description: Parents pay down payment or full amount online via payment gateway supporting card and e-wallet. The system marks assessments as paid upon confirmation and issues acknowledgment receipt numbers.
features.route_reason: Online payment integration with receipt issuance is a common integration feature.
features.justification: Payment gateway integration pattern with callbacks and reconciliation (patterns-payment_gateway_integration)
acceptance_criteria: Given an unpaid assessment, When the user pays successfully via card or e-wallet, Then the system marks the assessment as paid and issues an acknowledgment receipt number.
Given a payment gateway confirmation callback, When received, Then the system updates payment status accordingly.
Given a missing payment callback, When the daily reconciliation runs, Then mismatches are listed for finance review.
Given a payment, When processed, Then the system computes tuition and fees and accepts the payment online as per TOR.

args.query: online payment processing payment gateway card e-wallet receipt issuance

features.name: Parent notifications by email and SMS at enrollment steps
features.description: The system notifies parents via email and SMS when applications are submitted, returned, approved, assessed, paid, and when students are officially enrolled.
features.route_reason: Notifications by email and SMS at enrollment steps is standard notification functionality.
features.justification: Matches rubric criterion for a set of event-triggered email and SMS notifications through one provider with delivery log
acceptance_criteria: Given an application status change (submitted, returned, approved, assessed, paid, enrolled), When the status is saved, Then the parent receives an email notification.
Given an application status change (submitted, returned, approved, assessed, paid, enrolled), When the status is saved, Then the parent receives an SMS notification.
Given a notification delivery failure, When the SMS or email provider returns an error, Then the failure is logged and the message is retried once.
Given a certificate of enrollment is issued, When the student is officially enrolled, Then the parent receives a notification including the certificate.

args.query: parent notifications email SMS enrollment steps

features.name: Certificate of enrollment download and QR code verification
features.description: Once officially enrolled (approved, assigned section, down payment paid), parents can download a certificate of enrollment as PDF with official layout and QR code. Scanning the QR code opens a verification page showing certificate validity.
features.route_reason: Certificate download with QR code verification involves generating secure QR codes and verification pages, which is less common and requires BA attention.
features.justification: Matches pattern 'printable_official_form_certificate' typical size M for PDF with QR code and verification page
acceptance_criteria: Given a student is officially enrolled (approved, assigned section, down payment paid), When the parent downloads the certificate, Then a PDF with official layout and QR code is generated.
Given a certificate QR code is scanned, When the verification page is opened, Then it shows whether the certificate is valid.
Given the certificate PDF is generated, When viewed, Then it matches the school's official layout and includes the QR code.
Given the verification page is accessed via QR code, When the certificate is valid, Then the page confirms validity.

args.query: certificate of enrollment download PDF QR code verification

features.name: Class list report per section with export
features.description: Registrar can print class lists per section sorted by surname and export them to Excel.
features.route_reason: Class list report with export to Excel is a typical reporting feature.
features.justification: Standard tabular report with export to Excel per rubric and precedent P06-F10
acceptance_criteria: Given a section, When the registrar runs the class list report, Then the list is displayed sorted by surname.
Given the displayed class list, When the registrar exports, Then an Excel file with the same data downloads.
Given the class list report, When printed, Then the report prints per section as displayed.

args.query: class list report per section export Excel

features.name: Enrollment dashboard for administrators
features.description: School administrators see a dashboard showing application statuses, enrolled students per grade and section, seats remaining, payments collected vs assessments, and daily enrollment trends compared to previous year.
features.route_reason: Dashboard with enrollment statistics and trends is standard reporting and visualization.
features.justification: Matches rubric criterion for dashboard with 4-8 KPI widgets, charts, and date-range comparison (guideline-sizing_rubric_report_dashboard)
acceptance_criteria: Given a school administrator, When they open the enrollment dashboard, Then KPIs for application statuses, enrolled students per grade and section, seats remaining, payments collected vs assessments, and daily enrollment trends compared to previous year are shown.
Given a date range, When it is changed, Then all dashboard widgets refresh consistently showing updated data.
Given the dashboard, When viewed, Then data is scoped to the administrator's school and role as per TOR requirements.
Given the dashboard, When compared to previous year data, Then daily enrollment trends are displayed side-by-side as per TOR.

args.query: dashboard showing application statuses, enrolled students per grade and section, seats remaining, payments collected vs assessments, daily enrollment trends compared to previous year

features.name: School year and academic setup maintenance
features.description: Administrators maintain school years, grade levels, sections and capacities, required documents per grade level, age rules, fee tables, and discounts. Changes apply only to the selected school year.
features.route_reason: School setup and configuration maintenance is standard administrative functionality.
features.justification: Matches rubric criterion for maintaining several reference tables with validation and change history
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected school year, When administrators update grade levels, sections, capacities, required documents, age rules, fee tables, or discounts, Then changes apply only to that school year.
Given a change to fee tables or discounts, When saved, Then the system uses the updated values for the selected school year only.
Given a required document per grade level, When updated, Then the change is effective only for the selected school year.
Given an age rule change, When saved, Then it applies only to the selected school year.

args.query: school year and academic setup maintenance including grade levels, sections, capacities, required documents, age rules, fee tables, discounts

features.name: Staff user account and role management with access control
features.description: IT administrator creates staff accounts and assigns roles (registrar, accounting, administrator, IT admin). Each role sees only its own menus and actions.
features.route_reason: Staff user account and role management with access control is common administration feature.
features.justification: Matches precedent P01-F53 and rubric criterion for user and role administration without permission matrix
acceptance_criteria: Given an IT administrator, When they create a staff account and assign a role, Then the account is created with the assigned role as per TOR p4.
Given a user with a specific role, When they log in, Then they see only menus and actions allowed for that role as per TOR p4.
Given a deactivated user, When they attempt to log in, Then access is denied as per patterns-user_administration.

args.query: staff user account and role management with access control

features.name: Audit trail recording and search
features.description: The system records every create, update, approval, and payment action with user, date/time, and changed values. Administrators can search audit trails by user, student, and date.
features.route_reason: Audit trail recording and search is a typical compliance feature.
features.justification: patterns-audit_trail typical size M for audit trail recording and search
acceptance_criteria: Given a create, update, approval or payment action, When it occurs, Then the system records user, date/time, and changed values as an audit entry.
Given an administrator, When they search the audit trail by user, student, and date, Then matching audit entries are listed with pagination and export options.
Given an audit entry, When viewed, Then details of the change including before/after values are shown.

features.name: Migration of existing active student records with validation report
features.description: Vendor migrates active students and latest enrollment data from spreadsheets before online enrollment start and provides a validation report of rejected rows.
features.route_reason: Data migration is vendor activity, not software build work. — overridden: the guideline treats data migration as in-scope build work.
features.justification: Matches rubric for two to four source files, mapping rules, validation report, and one rehearsal run (guideline-sizing_rubric_data_migration)
acceptance_criteria: Given the spreadsheets of active students and latest enrollment data, When the migration runs, Then the data is imported into the system before online enrollment starts.
Given rows that fail validation during migration, When migration completes, Then a validation report of rejected rows with reasons is provided.
Given the migration rehearsal is conducted, When it completes, Then a rehearsal report is available to verify data correctness.
Given the final migration is conducted, When it completes, Then the system contains all active student records and latest enrollment data as per the spreadsheets.

args.query: migration of active student records with validation report

features.name: Payment gateway and SMS provider options proposal
features.description: The vendor shall propose options for payment gateway and SMS providers.
features.route_reason: Proposal of payment gateway and SMS providers is vendor advice, not software development.

questions.text: What is the preferred login method for parents and staff: local accounts with password or Single Sign-On (SSO)?

assumptions: Client responsibility (p1): The school will supply all computers, printers and scanners.
Client responsibility (p1): Payment gateway transaction fees and SMS charges are paid by the school directly to the providers.
Client responsibility (p3): The accounting office shall run a daily reconciliation listing payments recorded by the gateway but not matched in the system, and vice versa.
Client responsibility (p4): The school will clean the spreadsheets based on the validation report of rejected rows.
Client responsibility (p5): The school's IT administrator will be the product owner and will provide decisions within three working days.
Client responsibility (p5): The school will sign the contracts with the chosen payment gateway and SMS providers.
The system shall be secure and compliant with relevant laws including the Data Privacy Act.
The system shall be user-friendly and mobile-responsive.
The system shall be scalable to support about 2,000 parent households and staff users.
The system shall work on current versions of common desktop and mobile browsers.
Data shall be encrypted in transit and at rest.
The system shall be future-proof to allow enhancements and maintenance.
